description_en: This operation overwrites the specified push rule with the provided content. Therefore, to add a new rule item, you must include all existing rule items in the request; otherwise, they will be deleted

fields.help_en:
The name of the rule. Valid values:

CommitMessageChecker: The commit message rule.

CommitAuthorEmailChecker: The commit author email rule.

CommitAuthorChecker: The commit author check.

CommitCommitterChecker: The committer check.

ForcePushChecker: The force push check.

CommitFilesChecker: The committed file restriction
fields.help_zh:
规则名称，可选值：

CommitMessageChecker：提交说明规则
CommitAuthorEmailChecker：提交邮箱规则
CommitAuthorChecker：提交作者检查
CommitCommitterChecker：提交人检查
ForcePushChecker：禁止强制推送检查
CommitFilesChecker：提交文件限制规则
fields.name: checker_name

fields.help_en:
The restriction level for author and committer checks. This parameter applies only when checkerName is CommitAuthorChecker or CommitCommitterChecker. Valid values:

warn: Displays a warning but allows the push.

block: Blocks the push
fields.help_zh:
该字段作用于代码属主检查下的限制级别设置，仅检查作者和检查提交者有效，其他规则可不传值，可选值：
warn：仅警告，允许推送
block：禁止推送
fields.name: checker_type

fields.help_en:
Additional rule configuration. The expected value depends on the checkerName:

CommitMessageChecker: The regular expression for validation.

CommitAuthorEmailChecker: The regular expression for the email address.

ForcePushChecker: Set to "disabled".

CommitAuthorChecker: Set to "on" to enable the check.

CommitCommitterChecker: Set to "on" to enable the check
fields.help_zh:
在提交说明、提交邮箱、检查作者、检查提交人以及禁止强制推送时有效：
提交说明规则，extraMessage传入检查的正则表达式
提交邮箱规则，extraMessage传入检查的邮箱正则表示
禁止强制推送，extraMessage传入 "disabled"
检查作者规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
检查提交人规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
fields.name: extra_message

fields.help_en: An array of regular expressions to restrict committed files. This parameter applies only when checkerName is CommitFilesChecker
fields.help_zh: 该字段仅作用于提交文件限制，传入正则表达式，支持多条正则限制

`warn`: Displays a warning but allows the push.

checkerType.description_zh:
该字段作用于代码属主检查下的限制级别设置，仅检查作者和检查提交者有效，其他规则可不传值，可选值：

extraMessage.description_en:
Additional configuration for the rule. The value of this parameter depends on the selected `checkerName`:

For the commit message rule, this is the regular expression for validation.

For the commit author email rule, this is the regular expression for the author's email address.

For the force push check, use `disabled`.

For the commit author check, use `on`. This setting is optional.

For the committer check, use `on`. This setting is optional
extraMessage.description_zh:
在提交说明、提交邮箱、检查作者、检查提交人以及禁止强制推送时有效：

禁止强制推送，extraMessage传入 "disabled"

检查提交人规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值

fileRuleRegexes.description_en: An array of regular expressions that define restrictions on committed files. This parameter applies only when the checker name is `CommitFilesChecker`
fileRuleRegexes.description_zh: 该字段仅作用于提交文件限制，传入正则表达式，支持多条正则限制
